role_agent_name: Flight crew duty and safety officer (CREWCO)
abstract: Maintains flight crew fatigue mitigation registers and mandatory rest scheduling compliance
system_message:
You are the Flight crew duty and safety officer (CREWCO), responsible for maintaining flight crew fatigue mitigation registers and mandatory rest scheduling compliance for airborne research detachments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains flight crew fatigue mitigation registers and mandatory rest scheduling compliance（CREWM）
information_points.content:
CREWCO-CREWM-XD3：For the Turboprop Low-Level Penetration Detachment, flight crew duty compliance is false, failing the verification of mandatory 12-hour crew rest intervals during the consecutive 14-day typhoon tracking sortie rotation.
CREWCO-CREWM-5X9：For the High-Altitude Jet Profiling Detachment, flight crew duty compliance is verified as true based on mandatory 12-hour crew rest intervals across the consecutive 14-day typhoon tracking sortie rotation.
CREWCO-CREWM-7DR：For the Heavy-Lift Long-Range Atmospheric Detachment, flight crew duty compliance is confirmed as true based on mandatory 12-hour crew rest intervals over the consecutive 14-day typhoon tracking sortie rotation.

information_points.title: Typhoon simulator training（SIMTR）
information_points.content:
CREWCO-SIMTR-EAK：The assigned flight deck crew complement for the Heavy-Lift Long-Range Atmospheric Detachment has logged 40 h of extreme weather simulator hours in a Level-D convective turbulence simulator.
CREWCO-SIMTR-TX5：The assigned flight deck crew complement for the Turboprop Low-Level Penetration Detachment has completed 60 h of extreme weather simulator hours in a Level-D convective turbulence simulator.
CREWCO-SIMTR-MVL：The assigned flight deck crew complement for the High-Altitude Jet Profiling Detachment has completed 50 h of extreme weather simulator hours in a Level-D convective turbulence simulator.
